title: After homicide ruling, Boston councilor wants officers involved in South Bay jail death placed on leave
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Boston City Councilor Miniard Culpepper urges administrative leave for officers involved in Shacoby Kenny's homicide at South Bay jail.
State Medical Examiner ruled Shacoby Kenny's in-custody death a homicide due to lack of blood and oxygen to the brain.
Attorney General's office continues investigating Kenny's death; officials call for transparency and independent corrections oversight.

title: Norwood Hospital moves closer to being acquired through eminent domain
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: The Massachusetts Senate approved a bill to seize and transfer Norwood Hospital to a nonprofit entity via eminent domain.
Norwood Hospital has been closed since June 2020 due to flooding and subsequent bankruptcy by Steward Health Care.
The bill allows DCAMM to acquire the property and potentially lease it to a nonprofit healthcare operator.

title: Patriots rookie Eli Raridon is looking like a potential Day 1 contributor
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Eli Raridon, a Patriots 2026 third-round pick, is emerging as a potential backup tight end during training camp.
Raridon's quick adaptation is aided by Julian Hill's season-ending injury, creating an opportunity for regular playing time.
Head coach Mike Vrabel supports Raridon's growth, emphasizing speed and learning over mistake-free play.

title: Were they dishonest with me at the quick lube shop?
author: John Paul
bullets: A quick lube shop recommended air filter changes based on incomplete records, not dishonesty, according to AAA's Car Doctor.
Mercedes recommends brake fluid changes every three years due to moisture absorption, despite low mileage on older cars.
Subaru rear hatch opens intermittently; possible causes include weak battery or malfunctioning key fob or release switches.

title: Abington police officer placed on leave after chase of stolen car ends in crash that killed 17-year-old boy
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Abington police officer placed on leave after a chase led to a crash killing 17-year-old Sebastian Hamilton.
The stolen 2019 Hyundai Santa Fe crashed into a tree, seriously injuring four teenage passengers inside.
The officer's leave is standard procedure for investigation, not punitive, as noted by Police Chief John Bonney.

title: Madden 27 Ratings: Christian Gonzalez is NFL’s top-ranked CB in new game
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Christian Gonzalez is the top-ranked cornerback in Madden 27 with a 98 overall rating.
Gonzalez is one of five players with a 98 rating; six players achieved a 99 overall rating.
Madden 27 is set for worldwide release on August 13, with early access available on August 6.

title: Jeff Passan floats blockbuster trade for Red Sox and Marlins
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox linked to potential trade with Marlins for shortstop Otto Lopez and catcher Liam Hicks.
Otto Lopez hitting .329 with 9 home runs and 22 steals; considered a strong leadoff hitter.
Liam Hicks batting .279 with 14 home runs; seen as a power option at catcher for Boston.

title: Death of woman, 18, found dead in Mattapan home owned by Pressley’s husband ruled a homicide
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Yoseliani Ann Marte Ocasio, 18, died from a gunshot wound in a property owned by Conan Harris in Mattapan.
Police have classified Ocasio's death as a homicide with no arrests or charges filed as of Thursday.
Ayanna Pressley, whose husband owns the property, calls the incident devastating and a result of domestic violence.

title: Caleb Lomu is learning more than just right tackle at his first training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Caleb Lomu is training at multiple positions, including right tackle, guard, and jumbo tight end, during Patriots camp.
Patriots are preparing Lomu for versatility on the offensive line under Coach Mike Vrabel's guidance.
Lomu gained early recognition for performance in drills, adapting to the faster NFL pace with enthusiasm.

title: Kayshon Boutte addresses trade rumors, future with Patriots
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Kayshon Boutte, facing trade rumors, remains focused on the current season with the New England Patriots.
Patriots coach Mike Vrabel acknowledges potential trades amid crowded wide receiver roster, emphasizing competition enhancement.
Boutte's performance in training camp is strong, but New England may consider trading him due to contract concerns.
